method: 46 hash-verified public PRs, 173 TypeScript files, 52 frozen model-labeled file/rule positives per round. Paired within PR with alternating order and separate PR shuffle for each seed. All attempts included. PR wall time from parent submission through decoded receipt (includes first worker startup), excludes GitHub input retrieval. Control uses isolated warm daemon and one-shot edit hooks, eight files per event. A new stream worker is started in each round and checks one line at a time, using the same checks, tiers and up to eight workers. No model result cache. Nearest-rank percentiles; 95% percentile intervals resample paired PR clusters including their repeats. Phase times include instrumentation. First phase time is from submission and not provider processing time.
pilotDiagnosis: Bun 1.2.3 readline on process.stdin waited for EOF with a live pipe. Replaced with incremental fd reads and tested multiple replies while stdin remains open. Failed development attempts were excluded from confirmations and included in observed spend.

frozenScoreReplay.method: Intercepted TypeSafe fetch from the real stdin worker and returned prior saved model probabilities; checked each body SHA, every finding tier and unique per-PR file against the current calibrated hook.

spend.note: USD priced from returned TypeSafe input tokens at 0.042 per million; provider invoice unavailable. Includes development probes with usage receipts.
